card.name: First digit of two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: The first digit (often 1, 2 or 3) of a two-digit number such as 15, 25 or 35, and sometimes the word five before a plural noun. It appears in general prose and in dose or measurement amounts.

modes.label: Leading digit of a number
modes.description: The first digit of a two-digit number that is split into separate digits, before the final digit, in prices, ages, counts or doses.
modes.example: a first-run movie ticket in a neighborhood theater sold for <<1>>5 cents

modes.label: Spelled-out five
modes.description: The word five before decades, standing for a round count of years.
modes.example: resulting from<< five>> decades of nuclear weapons production

card.writes: It pushes toward ten-type number words and away from half and hundred terms, which suggests it helps the model predict the next digit or a round count.
card.plain: It marks the start of a two-digit number, where the model must pick the next digit.
